scope: 1.1-V gate; recorded +5-V SET and -1.7-V RESET DC protocols

validation_contract.scoring_eligibility: all paired raw cycles; no envelope rejection

zero_bias_policy.interpretation: The static model has I(0)=0. Measured zero-bias offset is reported as absolute-current median/max, not fitted or log-scored. Nonfinite predictions remain invalid at every voltage.

validation_contract.invalid_prediction_policy: report failed/invalid cycles; aggregate scores null for incomplete groups
validation_contract.median_loop_definition: RMSE between measured and predicted pointwise median curves; not the median individual-cycle RMSE
validation_contract.pointwise_branch_definition: native voltage points; apex belongs to forward and return; whole-cycle score counts every point once
